category: EU-hosted feature flags with local SDK evaluation

free_tier.stated: Free plan, EUR 0 a month, free forever, no card required: 500K requests a month, unlimited flags, 3 environments, 3 projects, 3 seats, all 12 SDKs, Discord support
free_tier.notes: Pricing is per SDK request, not per seat and not per monthly active user. The next plan, Starter, is EUR 45 a month billed monthly (EUR 39 annually) for 1M requests and 5 seats. The pricing page does not state what happens past 500K requests; the REST API docs say a request over the plan answers 429.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-flag value size cap is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: unverified: no flag-data retention period is stated on the pricing or API pages read; the pricing comparison lists a 3-day audit log retention on Free
retention.notes: A 3-day audit log retention appears in the vendor's pricing-comparison blog table; the main pricing page read here does not state a retention period.

egress.terms: not applicable: a flag service metered by SDK request count; no traffic allowance or byte price is published

interface_detail: A REST API manages flags, projects and users; SDKs for React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, browser, Node.js, Go, Python, Java, .NET, React Native and Flutter stream a resolved rules bundle over SSE and evaluate flags locally in-process, with no network hop per evaluation.
tooling: The 12 official SDKs, the REST API or any HTTP client; the SDK streams flag configuration and evaluates locally.
chaining: Serve flags to an app from a worker that uses a Rollgate SDK, keeping the SDK request count under 500K a month; SSE streaming and caching lower the effective request volume.

limits.value: 500K SDK requests a month on Free
3 environments, 3 projects and 3 seats on Free
the REST API answers 429 Too Many Requests when plan limits are exceeded
1 SSE connection on the Free plan

limits_note: Unlimited flags on every plan. The API docs list 500K requests, 1 SSE connection and 3 projects on Free; a request over the plan answers 429. The docs list 14-day free trials on paid plans.
binding_note: The 500K monthly request cap binds first for an app that polls flags frequently; a single SSE connection also caps concurrent streaming sessions on the Free plan.

identity_cost.detail: The quickstart says to sign up for a free Rollgate account with no credit card required; the architecture page lists user authentication by email and OAuth, and dashboard sign-in by Google and GitHub. The register page capture shows only a Terms and Privacy acceptance line, so the exact form fields are unverified: behind a sign-up; no card, phone or ID is stated at sign-up.

reliability_note: The API returns 429 when a plan limit is exceeded. Data is hosted in Germany on Hetzner and described as GDPR compliant by default. A 99.9% uptime SLA appears on the Growth plan only. Self-hosting is not yet available and is on the roadmap.
confidence_note: Every value is quoted from first-party pricing, REST API docs, quickstart, architecture and homepage pages. No account was opened; the exact register fields are unverified: behind a sign-up. No live flag evaluation was probed, so the record stays at documented rung.
